scripts.build: npm run build -w @paperfill/kernel && npm run build -w @paperfill/docx && npm run build -w @paperfill/xlsx && npm run build -w @paperfill/html && npm run build -w @paperfill/ui && npm run build -w @paperfill/pdf && npm run build -w @paperfill/vue && npm run build -w @paperfill/react && npm run build -w paperfill
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @paperfill/kernel && npm run typecheck -w @paperfill/kernel && npm run typecheck -w @paperfill/docx && npm run typecheck -w @paperfill/xlsx && npm run typecheck -w @paperfill/html && npm run typecheck -w @paperfill/ui && npm run typecheck -w @paperfill/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @paperfill/vue && npm run typecheck -w @paperfill/react && npm run typecheck -w paperfill
scripts.test: npm run build && tsx --test packages/kernel/test/*.test.ts packages/docx/test/*.test.ts packages/xlsx/test/*.test.ts packages/html/test/*.test.ts packages/ui/test/*.test.ts
